&\quad +\tfrac12v_{br',cw}D^{(2)}_{az,yr'}+\tfrac12v_{bz,cs'}D^{(2)}_{aw,ys'}-\tfrac12v_{br',cz}D^{(2)}_{aw,yr'} \\

&\quad +\tfrac12\delta_{yz}v_{bw,q's'}D^{(2)}_{q'a,cs'}+\tfrac12v_{bw,q'z}D^{(2)}_{q'a,yc} \\
&\quad -\tfrac12\delta_{cz}v_{bw,q's'}D^{(2)}_{q'a,ys'}-\tfrac12v_{bw,q's'}D^{(3)}_{q'az,ycs'} \\
&\quad -\tfrac12\delta_{yz}v_{br',q'w}D^{(2)}_{q'a,cr'}-\tfrac12v_{bz,q'w}D^{(2)}_{q'a,yc} \\
&\quad +\tfrac12\delta_{cz}v_{br',q'w}D^{(2)}_{q'a,yr'}+\tfrac12v_{br',q'w}D^{(3)}_{q'az,ycr'} \\
&\quad +\tfrac12\delta_{cw}v_{bz,q's'}D^{(2)}_{q'a,ys'}-\tfrac12\delta_{cw}v_{br',q'z}D^{(2)}_{q'a,yr'} \\
&\quad +\tfrac12v_{bz,q's'}D^{(3)}_{q'aw,ycs'}-\tfrac12v_{br',q'z}D^{(3)}_{q'aw,ycr'} \\
&\quad -\tfrac12\delta_{wy}v_{cz,bs'}D^{(1)}_{a,s'}+\tfrac12\delta_{wy}v_{cr',bz}D^{(1)}_{a,r'} \\
&\quad +\tfrac12\delta_{yz}v_{cw,bs'}D^{(1)}_{a,s'}-\tfrac12v_{cw,bz}D^{(1)}_{a,y}+\tfrac12v_{cw,bs'}D^{(2)}_{az,ys'} \\
&\quad -\tfrac12\delta_{yz}v_{cr',bw}D^{(1)}_{a,r'}+\tfrac12v_{cz,bw}D^{(1)}_{a,y}-\tfrac12v_{cr',bw}D^{(2)}_{az,yr'} \\
&\quad -\tfrac12v_{cz,bs'}D^{(2)}_{aw,ys'}+\tfrac12v_{cr',bz}D^{(2)}_{aw,yr'}+\tfrac12\delta_{wy}v_{cz,q's'}D^{(2)}_{q'a,bs'} \\
&\quad -\tfrac12\delta_{wy}v_{cr',q'z}D^{(2)}_{q'a,br'}-\tfrac12\delta_{yz}v_{cw,q's'}D^{(2)}_{q'a,bs'} \\
&\quad -\tfrac12v_{cw,q'z}D^{(2)}_{q'a,yb}+\tfrac12\delta_{bz}v_{cw,q's'}D^{(2)}_{q'a,ys'} \\
&\quad +\tfrac12v_{cw,q's'}D^{(3)}_{q'az,ybs'}+\tfrac12\delta_{yz}v_{cr',q'w}D^{(2)}_{q'a,br'} \\
&\quad +\tfrac12v_{cz,q'w}D^{(2)}_{q'a,yb}-\tfrac12\delta_{bz}v_{cr',q'w}D^{(2)}_{q'a,yr'} \\
&\quad -\tfrac12v_{cr',q'w}D^{(3)}_{q'az,ybr'}-\tfrac12\delta_{bw}v_{cz,q's'}D^{(2)}_{q'a,ys'} \\
&\quad +\tfrac12\delta_{bw}v_{cr',q'z}D^{(2)}_{q'a,yr'}-\tfrac12v_{cz,q's'}D^{(3)}_{q'aw,ybs'} \\
&\quad +\tfrac12v_{cr',q'z}D^{(3)}_{q'aw,ybr'}+\tfrac12\delta_{wy}v_{p'z,bs'}D^{(2)}_{p'a,cs'} \\
&\quad -\tfrac12\delta_{wy}v_{p'r',bz}D^{(2)}_{p'a,cr'}-\tfrac12\delta_{yz}v_{p'w,bs'}D^{(2)}_{p'a,cs'} \\
&\quad -\tfrac12v_{p'w,bz}D^{(2)}_{p'a,yc}+\tfrac12\delta_{cz}v_{p'w,bs'}D^{(2)}_{p'a,ys'} \\
&\quad +\tfrac12v_{p'w,bs'}D^{(3)}_{p'az,ycs'}+\tfrac12\delta_{yz}v_{p'r',bw}D^{(2)}_{p'a,cr'} \\
&\quad +\tfrac12v_{p'z,bw}D^{(2)}_{p'a,yc}-\tfrac12\delta_{cz}v_{p'r',bw}D^{(2)}_{p'a,yr'} \\
&\quad -\tfrac12v_{p'r',bw}D^{(3)}_{p'az,ycr'}-\tfrac12\delta_{cw}v_{p'z,bs'}D^{(2)}_{p'a,ys'} \\
&\quad +\tfrac12\delta_{cw}v_{p'r',bz}D^{(2)}_{p'a,yr'}-\tfrac12v_{p'z,bs'}D^{(3)}_{p'aw,ycs'} \\
&\quad +\tfrac12v_{p'r',bz}D^{(3)}_{p'aw,ycr'}-\tfrac12\delta_{wy}v_{p'z,cs'}D^{(2)}_{p'a,bs'} \\
&\quad +\tfrac12\delta_{wy}v_{p'r',cz}D^{(2)}_{p'a,br'}+\tfrac12\delta_{yz}v_{p'w,cs'}D^{(2)}_{p'a,bs'} \\
&\quad +\tfrac12v_{p'w,cz}D^{(2)}_{p'a,yb}-\tfrac12\delta_{bz}v_{p'w,cs'}D^{(2)}_{p'a,ys'} \\
&\quad -\tfrac12v_{p'w,cs'}D^{(3)}_{p'az,ybs'}-\tfrac12\delta_{yz}v_{p'r',cw}D^{(2)}_{p'a,br'} \\
&\quad -\tfrac12v_{p'z,cw}D^{(2)}_{p'a,yb}+\tfrac12\delta_{bz}v_{p'r',cw}D^{(2)}_{p'a,yr'} \\
&\quad +\tfrac12v_{p'r',cw}D^{(3)}_{p'az,ybr'}+\tfrac12\delta_{bw}v_{p'z,cs'}D^{(2)}_{p'a,ys'} \\
&\quad -\tfrac12\delta_{bw}v_{p'r',cz}D^{(2)}_{p'a,yr'}+\tfrac12v_{p'z,cs'}D^{(3)}_{p'aw,ybs'} \\
&\quad -\tfrac12v_{p'r',cz}D^{(3)}_{p'aw,ybr'}-\tfrac12\delta_{wy}v_{p'z,q's'}D^{(3)}_{p'q'a,cbs'} \\
&\quad +\tfrac12\delta_{wy}v_{p'r',q'z}D^{(3)}_{p'q'a,cbr'}+\tfrac12\delta_{yz}v_{p'w,q's'}D^{(3)}_{p'q'a,cbs'} \\
&\quad -\tfrac12v_{p'w,q'z}D^{(3)}_{p'q'a,ycb}+\tfrac12\delta_{bz}v_{p'w,q's'}D^{(3)}_{p'q'a,ycs'} \\
&\quad -\tfrac12\delta_{cz}v_{p'w,q's'}D^{(3)}_{p'q'a,ybs'}+\tfrac12v_{p'w,q's'}D^{(4)}_{p'q'az,ycbs'} \\
&\quad -\tfrac12\delta_{yz}v_{p'r',q'w}D^{(3)}_{p'q'a,cbr'}+\tfrac12v_{p'z,q'w}D^{(3)}_{p'q'a,ycb} \\
&\quad -\tfrac12\delta_{bz}v_{p'r',q'w}D^{(3)}_{p'q'a,ycr'}+\tfrac12\delta_{cz}v_{p'r',q'w}D^{(3)}_{p'q'a,ybr'} \\
&\quad -\tfrac12v_{p'r',q'w}D^{(4)}_{p'q'az,ycbr'}-\tfrac12\delta_{bw}v_{p'z,q's'}D^{(3)}_{p'q'a,ycs'} \\
&\quad +\tfrac12\delta_{bw}v_{p'r',q'z}D^{(3)}_{p'q'a,ycr'}+\tfrac12\delta_{cw}v_{p'z,q's'}D^{(3)}_{p'q'a,ybs'} \\
&\quad -\tfrac12\delta_{cw}v_{p'r',q'z}D^{(3)}_{p'q'a,ybr'}-\tfrac12v_{p'z,q's'}D^{(4)}_{p'q'aw,ycbs'} \\
&\quad +\tfrac12v_{p'r',q'z}D^{(4)}_{p'q'aw,ycbr'}-\delta_{ab}\delta_{cw}h_{yq'}D^{(1)}_{z,q'} \\
&\quad +\delta_{ab}\delta_{cz}h_{yq'}D^{(1)}_{w,q'}+\delta_{ab}h_{yq'}D^{(2)}_{wz,cq'} \\
&\quad +\delta_{ac}\delta_{bw}h_{yq'}D^{(1)}_{z,q'}-\delta_{ac}\delta_{bz}h_{yq'}D^{(1)}_{w,q'} \\
&\quad -\delta_{ac}h_{yq'}D^{(2)}_{wz,bq'}-\delta_{bw}\delta_{cz}h_{yq'}D^{(1)}_{a,q'}-\delta_{bw}h_{yq'}D^{(2)}_{az,cq'} \\
&\quad +\delta_{bz}\delta_{cw}h_{yq'}D^{(1)}_{a,q'}+\delta_{cw}h_{yq'}D^{(2)}_{az,bq'}+\delta_{bz}h_{yq'}D^{(2)}_{aw,cq'} \\
&\quad -\delta_{cz}h_{yq'}D^{(2)}_{aw,bq'}+h_{yq'}D^{(3)}_{awz,cbq'} \\
&\quad -\tfrac12\delta_{ab}\delta_{cw}v_{yr',q's'}D^{(2)}_{q'z,s'r'} \\
&\quad +\tfrac12\delta_{ab}\delta_{cw}v_{p'r',ys'}D^{(2)}_{p'z,s'r'} \\
&\quad +\tfrac12\delta_{ab}\delta_{cz}v_{yr',q's'}D^{(2)}_{q'w,s'r'} \\
&\quad -\tfrac12\delta_{ab}\delta_{cz}v_{p'r',ys'}D^{(2)}_{p'w,s'r'}+\tfrac12\delta_{ab}v_{yr',cs'}D^{(2)}_{wz,s'r'} \\
&\quad -\tfrac12\delta_{ab}v_{yr',q's'}D^{(3)}_{q'wz,cs'r'}-\tfrac12\delta_{ab}v_{cr',ys'}D^{(2)}_{wz,s'r'} \\
&\quad +\tfrac12\delta_{ab}v_{p'r',ys'}D^{(3)}_{p'wz,cs'r'}+\tfrac12\delta_{ac}\delta_{bw}v_{yr',q's'}D^{(2)}_{q'z,s'r'} \\
&\quad -\tfrac12\delta_{ac}\delta_{bw}v_{p'r',ys'}D^{(2)}_{p'z,s'r'} \\
&\quad -\tfrac12\delta_{ac}\delta_{bz}v_{yr',q's'}D^{(2)}_{q'w,s'r'} \\
&\quad +\tfrac12\delta_{ac}\delta_{bz}v_{p'r',ys'}D^{(2)}_{p'w,s'r'}-\tfrac12\delta_{ac}v_{yr',bs'}D^{(2)}_{wz,s'r'} \\
&\quad +\tfrac12\delta_{ac}v_{yr',q's'}D^{(3)}_{q'wz,bs'r'}+\tfrac12\delta_{ac}v_{br',ys'}D^{(2)}_{wz,s'r'} \\
&\quad -\tfrac12\delta_{ac}v_{p'r',ys'}D^{(3)}_{p'wz,bs'r'}-\tfrac12\delta_{bw}\delta_{cz}v_{yr',q's'}D^{(2)}_{q'a,s'r'} \\
&\quad +\tfrac12\delta_{bw}\delta_{cz}v_{p'r',ys'}D^{(2)}_{p'a,s'r'}-\tfrac12\delta_{bw}v_{yr',cs'}D^{(2)}_{az,s'r'} \\
&\quad +\tfrac12\delta_{bw}v_{yr',q's'}D^{(3)}_{q'az,cs'r'}+\tfrac12\delta_{bw}v_{cr',ys'}D^{(2)}_{az,s'r'} \\
&\quad -\tfrac12\delta_{bw}v_{p'r',ys'}D^{(3)}_{p'az,cs'r'}+\tfrac12\delta_{bz}\delta_{cw}v_{yr',q's'}D^{(2)}_{q'a,s'r'} \\
&\quad -\tfrac12\delta_{bz}\delta_{cw}v_{p'r',ys'}D^{(2)}_{p'a,s'r'}+\tfrac12\delta_{cw}v_{yr',bs'}D^{(2)}_{az,s'r'} \\
&\quad -\tfrac12\delta_{cw}v_{yr',q's'}D^{(3)}_{q'az,bs'r'}-\tfrac12\delta_{cw}v_{br',ys'}D^{(2)}_{az,s'r'} \\
&\quad +\tfrac12\delta_{cw}v_{p'r',ys'}D^{(3)}_{p'az,bs'r'}+\tfrac12\delta_{bz}v_{yr',cs'}D^{(2)}_{aw,s'r'} \\
&\quad -\tfrac12\delta_{bz}v_{yr',q's'}D^{(3)}_{q'aw,cs'r'}-\tfrac12\delta_{bz}v_{cr',ys'}D^{(2)}_{aw,s'r'} \\
&\quad +\tfrac12\delta_{bz}v_{p'r',ys'}D^{(3)}_{p'aw,cs'r'}-\tfrac12\delta_{cz}v_{yr',bs'}D^{(2)}_{aw,s'r'} \\
&\quad +\tfrac12\delta_{cz}v_{yr',q's'}D^{(3)}_{q'aw,bs'r'}+\tfrac12\delta_{cz}v_{br',ys'}D^{(2)}_{aw,s'r'} \\
&\quad -\tfrac12\delta_{cz}v_{p'r',ys'}D^{(3)}_{p'aw,bs'r'}+\tfrac12v_{yr',bs'}D^{(3)}_{awz,cs'r'} \\
&\quad -\tfrac12v_{yr',cs'}D^{(3)}_{awz,bs'r'}+\tfrac12v_{yr',q's'}D^{(4)}_{q'awz,cbs'r'} \\
&\quad -\tfrac12v_{br',ys'}D^{(3)}_{awz,cs'r'}+\tfrac12v_{cr',ys'}D^{(3)}_{awz,bs'r'} \\
&\quad -\tfrac12v_{p'r',ys'}D^{(4)}_{p'awz,cbs'r'}
\end{align*}

\noindent ERPA, $\mathcal M_{(pq),(rs)}=\langle[\hat E_{qp},[\hat H_A,\hat E_{rs}]]\rangle$ (natural-orbital basis) (20 terms, RDM orders [1, 2]):
\begin{align*}
&+h_{pr}D^{(1)}_{q,s}-\tfrac12v_{pr,q's'}D^{(2)}_{q'q,ss'}+\tfrac12v_{pr',q'r}D^{(2)}_{q'q,sr'} \\
&\quad +\tfrac12v_{p'r,ps'}D^{(2)}_{p'q,ss'}-\tfrac12v_{p'r',pr}D^{(2)}_{p'q,sr'}-\delta_{pr}h_{sq'}D^{(1)}_{q,q'} \\
&\quad -\tfrac12\delta_{pr}v_{sr',q's'}D^{(2)}_{q'q,s'r'}+\tfrac12\delta_{pr}v_{p'r',ss'}D^{(2)}_{p'q,s'r'} \\
&\quad -\tfrac12v_{sr',ps'}D^{(2)}_{qr,s'r'}+\tfrac12v_{pr',ss'}D^{(2)}_{qr,s'r'}-\delta_{qs}h_{p'r}D^{(1)}_{p',p} \\
&\quad -\tfrac12\delta_{qs}v_{p'r,q's'}D^{(2)}_{p'q',ps'}-\tfrac12v_{p'r,q'q}D^{(2)}_{p'q',sp} \\
&\quad +\tfrac12\delta_{qs}v_{p'r',q'r}D^{(2)}_{p'q',pr'}+\tfrac12v_{p'q,q'r}D^{(2)}_{p'q',sp}+h_{sq}D^{(1)}_{r,p} \\
&\quad -\tfrac12v_{sq,q's'}D^{(2)}_{q'r,ps'}+\tfrac12v_{sr',q'q}D^{(2)}_{q'r,pr'}+\tfrac12v_{p'q,ss'}D^{(2)}_{p'r,ps'} \\
&\quad -\tfrac12v_{p'r',sq}D^{(2)}_{p'r,pr'}
\end{align*}
